answer: Make trust a voyage no farm can shortcut: a newcomer must sail a route of useful work across unrelated domains, each leg ending on a knoll where a different veteran checks the cargo and stamps the log, so standing grows only from real, proven passage. The log is sealed as a fable of the voyage, bound to one key and impossible to copy, and random harbour audits re-read it each epoch, freezing any whose stamps repeat signers. Sybil farms must fund a voyage, pass fresh knoll keepers, and survive audits for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
